gate_criterion: per-scene LOSO coverage within ±0.05 of nominal 0.9 on ≥3 held-out Imja-area scenes (DL_PRIMARY_ROADMAP Level 2.2)
split: leave-one-scene-out — no scene contributes pixels to its own conformal quantile
label_semantics: gold S2-SCL/analyst water masks sampled to the SAR grid; coverage is vs those labels on labelled pixels only
caveats: Labelled pixels within a scene are spatially correlated — effective sample size ≪ pixel count; per-scene coverage is the honest unit.
3 scenes is the minimum the roadmap accepts — coverage dispersion across a larger scene set is unmeasured.
